title: Tallow Retailer Configuration
description: Per-retailer scraping configuration for the Tallow deals engine.

deals_page_url.description: URL for the main deals/clearance page

product_selector.description: CSS selector or HTML marker for product cards

price_selector.description: CSS selector or regex for price element

stock_selector.description: CSS selector or text marker for stock status

sku_pattern.description: Regex pattern for SKU/product ID extraction from URLs

api_endpoints.description: Known API endpoints for this retailer

requires_browser.description: Whether this retailer requires browser rendering
